 Adbiotech Acquires 51% Stake in Korean Distribution Company of Kazakhstan K-Beauty Platform 'Bestee'
 by Jang Hyowon 
 Published 19 Nov.2026 10:08(KST) 
 Share 
 Language 
 Text Size 
 Print 
 View original image 
 Kosdaq-listed Adbiotech is moving to tap the Central Asian cosmetics market by acquiring a 51% stake in the Korean distribution company of Kazakhstan-based K-beauty platform Bestee. The company plans to oversee the discovery of Korean cosmetics brands, product sourcing and exports, while generating new revenue by leveraging Bestee's local distribution network and influencer network.
 Adbiotech said on November 19 that it had acquired a 51% stake in Bestee's Korean distribution company. It will oversee the discovery of promising Korean cosmetics brands, product sourcing, supply contracts and export operations. By securing a majority stake in the Korean distribution company, Adbiotech has established a foundation to directly lead a distribution system linking the supply of Korean products with local sales in Central Asia.
 The acquisition follows up on a strategic business partnership announced last October. At the time, Adbiotech presented a business model to identify competitive Korean cosmetics brands and sell their products through Bestee's local platform. The latest stake acquisition gives Adbiotech a structure for directly managing product supply and distribution operations.
 Bestee is responsible for its local distribution network in Kazakhstan and influencer marketing. According to the company, Bestee has a network of more than 140 local influencers, whose social media accounts have a combined following of about 45 million. The influencers introduce products to local consumers through platforms such as Instagram and TikTok, encouraging them to make purchases.
 The marketing strategy focuses on converting interest into actual purchases rather than simply increasing advertising exposure. Local influencers will use Korean cosmetics and create content featuring reviews and instructions on how to use the products, then direct consumers to purchase them through online platforms. The company plans to ease the burden of entering the market for Korean brands by adopting performance-based marketing, in which influencers receive commissions based on sales.
 Artificial intelligence (AI)-based personalized skin consultations are also being positioned as a competitive advantage in distribution. Bestee is developing a service that analyzes consumers' skin conditions and lifestyles, matches them with data on about 1,800 cosmetic ingredients, and recommends skincare products suited to each individual's skin characteristics. The strategy is to boost conversion rates by combining personalized product recommendations with influencer marketing.
 The growth potential of the Central Asian beauty market is another reason for the business expansion. According to the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA), the Central Asian beauty market is projected to grow from about $2.4 billion in 2022 to about $3.7 billion in 2027.
 Adbiotech plans to build an integrated distribution system encompassing Korean brand sourcing, local marketing, online sales and consumer data analysis. It will use its local influencer network to gather consumer responses and sales data for each product, then apply those insights to the supply of new products from Korean manufacturers and the discovery of additional brands. The company also plans to expand its product range beyond skincare and color cosmetics to include inner beauty products and beauty devices.
 The company plans to use Kazakhstan as a foothold to expand into neighboring countries, including Uzbekistan and Kyrgyzstan. In the medium to long term, it is also considering entering nearby markets such as Russia.

 An Adbiotech representative said, "The significance of acquiring a stake in the Korean distribution company is that we have secured a distribution platform that directly connects outstanding Korean cosmetics companies with Central Asian consumers." The representative added, "By combining Adbiotech's sourcing capabilities with Bestee's influencer network and AI technology, we will generate new revenue and develop our global K-beauty distribution business into a new core growth engine."
